status: Proposed law registry; no Bend proofs implemented in this handoff.

laws.name: Identity mapping
laws.statement: identify is injective; lookup round-trips within one universe.

laws.name: Generation lifting
laws.statement: Append-only lifting preserves membership of old identities and union/intersection/difference; new members are absent.
laws.unlocks: Reuse old set roots after universe growth

laws.name: Pointwise set operations
laws.statement: Member(union/intersection/difference(A,B),x) equals the Boolean specification.

laws.name: Representation refinement
laws.statement: Empty/full/sparse/dense/branch denotations agree with membership and validate ranges/tails.

laws.name: Representation conversion
laws.statement: decode(convert(A)) = decode(A), including sparse/dense and zero/full compression.

laws.name: Boolean rewrites
laws.statement: Each admitted Boolean rewrite preserves membership in one universe.

laws.name: Persistent updates
laws.statement: Returned updated root has patch semantics; every retained old root has unchanged denotation.

laws.name: Least fixed point
laws.statement: C(R) is the least edge-closed set containing R.

laws.name: Traversal refinement
laws.statement: Production frontier traversal returns C(R) and terminates on admitted finite graphs.

laws.name: Closure algebra
laws.statement: Closure is extensive, monotone, idempotent, empty-preserving and union-preserving.

laws.name: Closure certificate soundness/completeness
laws.statement: The rank/predecessor and edge-closure checker accepts only exact closures; every finite exact closure admits such a certificate.
laws.unlocks: Checked cached or alternative closure proposals

laws.name: Checkpoint shortcut
laws.statement: Replacing exploration at a vertex by its validated cached closure preserves the full result.
laws.unlocks: Checkpoint indexes and shared ancestor reuse

laws.name: Least missing set
laws.statement: K subset H union T iff (K minus H) subset T, for K=C(R) and arbitrary H.

laws.name: Readiness
laws.statement: isReady(K,H) iff K subset H iff K minus H is empty.

laws.name: Missing composition
laws.statement: (A union B) minus H = (A minus H) union (B minus H); A minus (H1 union H2) = (A minus H1) minus H2.
laws.unlocks: Shared requirements and tiered inventory filtering

laws.name: Ordinal partition
laws.statement: Disjoint valid ordinal intervals cover the result exactly once; pointwise Boolean operations commute with restriction.

laws.name: Disjoint statistics
laws.statement: Stats(disjoint_union tiles)=fold(componentwise_add, Stats(tiles)).

laws.name: Validated query rewrites
laws.statement: For every admitted rewrite, denotation before equals denotation after; validation precedes elimination.

laws.name: Fused difference statistics
laws.statement: FusedStats(A,B)=Stats(decode(A) minus decode(B)).

laws.name: Compiler soundness
laws.statement: observe(execute(compile(W,q)))=denote(q,W) for admitted total core inputs.

laws.name: Batch deduplication
laws.statement: Deduplicating equal requests/operand pairs and restoring caller positions preserves every result and order.

laws.name: Inventory maintenance
laws.statement: maintain(K,H,remove,add)=fresh(K,(H minus remove) union add).

laws.name: Graph extension
laws.statement: Under complete unchanged old outgoing adjacency, old-root closure is preserved by the identity embedding.

laws.name: Cache binding
laws.statement: A reused value is bound to exact universe/graph/policy/root/weight/input generations.
laws.unlocks: Prevent stale graph and metric reuse

laws.name: Reachability witness
laws.statement: Returned explanation begins at a requested root, ends at the requested object, and every step is a policy edge.

laws.name: Word refinement
laws.statement: U32 difference/popcount and final-word masking implement bounded bit membership/count.

laws.name: Checked numeric refinement
laws.statement: Limb conversion/addition/comparison agree with Naturals in range; overflow is detected.

laws.name: Plan execution refinement
laws.statement: Every leaf/reduction executes its specified result with bounded reads and exclusive output writes under documented backend contracts.

laws.name: Serialization
laws.statement: decode(encode(valid_value)) preserves denotation; accepted untrusted data satisfies structural invariants.

laws.name: Metadata parser
laws.statement: Parsing is sound and complete within declared metadata grammar and explicit size limits.

laws.name: Git policies
laws.statement: Parsed Git objects map to exactly the specified full/tree-data internal edges and external references.

laws.name: Inventory projection
laws.statement: Projection into source universe contains exactly the recorded source-domain OIDs, without assuming closure.

forbidden_rewrites: C(A intersect B) = C(A) intersect C(B)
C(A minus B) = C(A) minus C(B)
Stats(A union B) = Stats(A) + Stats(B) without disjointness
Reach(R) intersect tile = Reach_in_induced_tile(R intersect tile)
Resolve an invalid input only after eliminating it by a rewrite
